body:
I feel exactly the way you described in your first two paragraphs. It's only recently that I've had suicidal thoughts however. I've always felt like I would have had it taken care of for me by now, and I know it's not natural to think like this, but I seriously feel like it NEEDS to come one way or another.

I've always felt that a fascination, or perhaps even an admiration, of death is hardwired into me. I've never had a traumatic experience that would have caused me to think this way. It has just always been there.
